name: Painting
responsibility: Paints a settled drawing into a scene: architecture and sequence marks, card surfaces and ports, the theme's colours and the atlas; other crates get only the few sizes and looks they place by
description: Its builders (paint/build.rs) are the producer's own: the setters, the producer-only constructors and Text::set, private to the crate (ADR 0091). It asks the pulse train for a mark's pulse breadth and for an exchange's turn distance. The sizes it draws by sit in the crate-private sheet sizes.rs, shared only with the measurer (ADR 0088). Other crates call paint, viewer_marks, junction_boxes, own_icons, diagram_margin, straight_card_top_contains, tab_width and header_padding. The far view's widths and scale stay behind viewer_marks, and paint decides a part's icon: NodeAppearance.icon is optional, and a part's TypeKind has a Flow variant.
